name: boundary-monorepo
description: Errors, debugging, and failure policy for HTTP APIs. Throw on the server, policy on the client, proof in CI.

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/server packages/client packages/next packages/conform && npm run build:cjs
scripts.build:cjs: tsc -p packages/server/tsconfig.cjs.json && tsc -p packages/client/tsconfig.cjs.json && tsc -p packages/next/tsconfig.cjs.json && tsc -p packages/conform/tsconfig.cjs.json && node scripts/stamp-cjs.mjs
scripts.clean: tsc -b packages/server packages/client packages/next packages/conform --clean && rm -rf packages/*/dist
